title: Universal cross-OS, local, remote, and cloud agent secret resolution
goal: Ensure every Susi agent and subprocess across Windows (x86_64/arm64), Linux (x86_64/arm64, systemd & container), and macOS (x86_64/arm64) receives required secrets and unlock material automatically without prompts or plaintext leakage.

reuse.reason: Extends susi-config::vault_store/keepass_bridge/cloud_env and susi-harness::secrets/router/verify rather than adding separate secret stores.
reuse.searched: Checked susi-config, susi-harness, susi-daemon, susi-daemon-runtime, susi-gemi, susi-gemi-models, susi-tools, deploy/compose.
